bundles.evidenceText: therefore it follows logically that the transcendent cause of the universe is an unembodied mind
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the universe's transcendent cause cannot be an abstract object and must instead be an unembodied mind and personal creator. This supports the subsidiary bridge from the universe's beginning and causal need to an uncaused, immaterial transcendent cause. The assertion would make that bridge more credible, so compatibility with no contact fails. The pro motion bridge is excluded because this is one cosmological inference, not the complete five-line comparison.

bundles.evidenceText: hence we have good reason to think that to the fine-tuning is not due to either physical necessity or chance
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that fine-tuning exhibits both extreme improbability and an independent pattern, excludes physical necessity and chance, and infers design. This supports the subsidiary bridge that intelligent design better explains life-permitting fine-tuning than necessity or chance. That inferential proposition cannot remain true without increasing the bridge's credibility. The pro central bridge is excluded because the move addresses only fine-tuning, not cumulative convergence of all five lines.

bundles.evidenceText: real evil in the world actually serves to prove the existence of God
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that objective moral facts exist and require God as their ground. No stated subsidiary bridge concerns the moral argument. Compatibility therefore requires no contact: this moral-grounding claim can be true without establishing or undermining any listed cosmology, fine-tuning, resurrection, evil-and-hiddenness, or Kalam bridge. The nearest competitor, support for the pro motion bridge, is excluded because one moral line does not state the complete five-line motion conclusion.

bundles.evidenceText: there just is no plausible naturalistic explanation of these facts
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the reported appearances, the disciples' resurrection belief, and the associated facts lack a naturalistic explanation and are explained by Jesus rising from the dead. This supports the subsidiary resurrection bridge. The proposition directly increases the credibility of God raising Jesus and is incompatible with no contact. The pro central bridge is the nearest competitor but is excluded because the move establishes only the resurrection line, not the cumulative convergence of five evidential lines.

bundles.evidenceText: you can know that God exists wholly apart from arguments simply by immediately experiencing him
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that immediate personal experience can disclose God's existence without an argument. No stated subsidiary bridge represents religious experience. The claim can remain true while every listed bridge concerning Kalam, fine-tuning, resurrection, evil, or hiddenness retains exactly the same credibility, so the no-contact default applies. Support for the pro motion bridge is excluded because the move presents one experiential route and does not assert the complete comparative conclusion from all five evidential lines.

bundles.evidenceText: these methods of acquiring and maintaining beliefs cannot be relied upon to deliver truth
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that similar religious belief-forming methods produce mutually conflicting systems and therefore are unreliable. No listed bridge states that generic epistemic-method proposition. It can be true even if the five particular evidential inferences either succeed or fail, so compatibility yields no contact. The nearest competitor is support for the con central bridge, but that bridge specifically concerns the five proposed lines, underdetermination, and contrary empirical evidence, none of which is asserted here as a collective proposition.

bundles.evidenceText: the rational attitude in the absence of a very strong case for the existence of a Christian God is to believe that there is no such thing
bundles.rationale: The move asserts the complete negative conclusion that, absent an overwhelmingly strong case for the specific Christian God, belief should be withheld or rejected. This supports the con motion bridge that the cited case does not make Christian theism more reasonable and supports withholding or rejection. The proposition cannot retain its expressed force without increasing that bridge's credibility. The con central bridge is excluded because the move does not specifically assert that all five inferences are underdetermined and face contrary empirical evidence.

bundles.evidenceText: I've never experienced things coming into existence from nothing
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that ordinary experience concerns rearrangements of existing material and cannot establish that creation from nothing is causally governed. This directly attacks a necessary causal inference in the pro Kalam subsidiary bridge. If the asserted experiential limitation holds, that bridge becomes less credible, defeating compatibility with no contact. Support for the parallel con Kalam bridge is excluded under the direct-attack rule because the move is expressly challenging the pro bridge's causal premise.

bundles.evidenceText: it doesn't show anything like as much as bill needs
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the Borde-Guth-Vilenkin result establishes only a beginning of expansion, permits prior contraction, and cannot justify confidence about an absolute cosmic beginning. This directly attacks the finite-beginning premise of the pro Kalam subsidiary bridge. The proposition would reduce that bridge's credibility and thus fails the compatibility test for no contact. Support for the con Kalam bridge is excluded because the expressed force is a direct attack on Craig's pro inference, and direct attacks belong to the bridge attacked.

bundles.evidenceText: the idea that a mind might exist in the absence of the entire physical universe is complete speculation
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that identifying a nonphysical cosmic cause specifically as a mind is speculative because minds are not evidenced apart from physical substrates. The listed pro Kalam bridge concludes only an uncaused, timeless, spaceless, immaterial transcendent cause; it does not require that cause to be a mind. The move can therefore be true while that bridge remains true, so no contact applies. Attack on the pro Kalam bridge is the nearest competitor but is excluded by this compatibility distinction.

bundles.evidenceText: there is no one method which is common to all religions which leads to these conflicting beliefs
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that religious diversity does not expose one common unreliable method and that Craig's own method combines logic, evidence, and experience. No stated bridge has that generic methodological proposition as a premise. It can remain true while the five specific pro inferences or the con underdetermination claim retain their credibility, so no contact applies. Attack on the con central bridge is excluded because this move does not address that bridge's proposition about all five evidential lines and contrary empirical evidence.

bundles.evidenceText: we've got good cosmological evidence that the universe began to exist
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the Borde-Guth-Vilenkin theorem is independent of a quantum-gravity description, supports an absolute cosmic beginning, and leads to the claim that the beginning has a cause. This supports the pro Kalam subsidiary bridge from finite beginning and causal need to a transcendent cause. The assertion increases that bridge's credibility and cannot satisfy compatibility with no contact. Attack on the con Kalam bridge is excluded because this atomic move positively builds the pro beginning-and-cause inference rather than directly addressing ordinary causal experience.

bundles.evidenceText: it's absurd to think that something could pop into being with neither a material nor an efficient cause
bundles.rationale: The move directly denies the con Kalam proposition that the absence of ordinary experience of creation ex nihilo leaves the causal inference unsupported. It asserts that origin without either a material or efficient cause is still more impossible and invokes Hume's rejection of uncaused origin. This attacks the con Kalam subsidiary bridge, and the asserted denial would reduce its credibility. Support for the pro Kalam bridge is excluded because the expressed structure is a direct reply to, and attack on, the con bridge.

bundles.evidenceText: this constitutes a phenomenon which very naturally invites explanation in terms of a cosmic scale designer
bundles.rationale: The move asserts conditionally that if the constants are physically inexplicable and precisely tuned among alternatives, the resulting phenomenon naturally calls for a cosmic designer. This supplies support for the pro fine-tuning subsidiary bridge because its stated condition expressly excludes a physical explanation and favors design. The proposition increases that bridge's credibility, so no contact is incompatible. The con fine-tuning bridge is excluded because this atomic move concedes the design inference rather than asserting uncertainty, a deeper theory, or a multiverse.

bundles.evidenceText: our experiments and observations have a sample size of 1
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that fine-tuning probabilities are uncertain given a single observed universe and that deeper physics, inflation, or multiple universes may explain the apparent coincidences. These claims directly attack the pro subsidiary bridge that design explains fine-tuning better than necessity or chance. If they hold, that bridge becomes less credible, so no contact is incompatible. Support for the con fine-tuning bridge is excluded under the direct-attack rule because the move expressly targets the pro design inference.

bundles.evidenceText: the fine-tuning argument does nothing to support the claim that God is good rather than evil
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that fine-tuning cannot distinguish a morally perfect Christian God from an equally powerful evil or neutral designer. This supports the con fine-tuning subsidiary bridge's specific proposition that fine-tuning does not identify an omniperfect Christian God. The proposition increases that bridge's credibility. Attack on the pro fine-tuning bridge is excluded by compatibility: intelligent design could still explain fine-tuning better than chance or necessity even while the designer's moral character remains unidentified.

bundles.evidenceText: there's absolutely nothing mysterious or contradictory about any of this
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that apparently inconsistent infinity subtraction merely reflects a non-unique inverse operation and creates no contradiction in infinite arithmetic. This directly attacks Craig's infinity-based premise for the finite beginning within the pro Kalam subsidiary bridge. If the asserted account holds, that route to the bridge is less credible, defeating compatibility with no contact. The con Kalam subsidiary is excluded because it concerns causal extrapolation to creation ex nihilo, not the coherence of an infinite past.

bundles.evidenceText: I don't see any grounds for thinking that's highly probable
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that Millican has not established that God's existence would probably produce a more obvious divine presence. This directly attacks the opaque-presence inference in the con subsidiary bridge that the observed world is less expected from a morally perfect God. The assertion would reduce that bridge's credibility. Support for the pro central bridge is excluded because the move targets one hiddenness-based con inference rather than asserting cumulative convergence of the five pro lines or the absence of every comparable atheist reason.

bundles.evidenceText: I submit in reality that's absurd
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that subtracting identical infinite cardinalities but obtaining nonidentical results is unacceptable for real collections, thereby defending the impossibility of an actual infinite past. This supports the finite-beginning premise within the pro Kalam subsidiary bridge and increases that bridge's credibility. No contact is therefore incompatible. Attack on the con Kalam bridge is excluded because that bridge concerns extrapolating ordinary causation to creation ex nihilo, whereas this move concerns the separate finite-past premise.

bundles.evidenceText: the issue of fine tuning is not likely to be resolved by a future physics
bundles.rationale: The move expressly denies that fine-tuning probability claims are defective and denies that future physics is likely to remove the multiple, diverse cases of fine-tuning. This directly attacks the con fine-tuning subsidiary bridge's claims of epistemic uncertainty and deeper physical explanation. The assertion would reduce that bridge's credibility. Support for the pro design bridge is excluded under the direct-attack rule because the move's expressed structure is a rebuttal of the con bridge, even though it also calls the fine-tuning case compelling.

bundles.evidenceText: there's no reason why an atheist has to presuppose that humans have no intrinsic value
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that an atheist can perceive and affirm objective moral values and intrinsic human value without knowing their ontology or positing God. No listed subsidiary bridge states the moral-grounding argument. This proposition can remain true while the listed Kalam, fine-tuning, resurrection, evil, and hiddenness bridges retain the same credibility, so no contact applies. Attack on the pro motion bridge is excluded because the move addresses one moral inference and does not attack the complete five-line comparative conclusion.

bundles.evidenceText: these are not independent reports but even so they contain many discrepancies
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the Gospel accounts were written later by committed Christians, are textually dependent, and contain discrepancies, making them a weak basis for a resurrection inference. This directly attacks evidential premises required by the pro resurrection subsidiary bridge. If the asserted dependence and discrepancies hold, that bridge becomes less credible, so no contact is incompatible. Support for the con central bridge is excluded because the move targets the resurrection bridge specifically rather than all five evidential lines collectively.

bundles.evidenceText: short of God any sort of explanatory stopping point is just arbitrary
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that atheism cannot nonarbitrarily ground intrinsic human value, moral flourishing, obligation, or prohibition without a moral lawgiver. No stated subsidiary bridge represents the moral argument. The claim can remain true without altering the credibility of any listed Kalam, fine-tuning, resurrection, or evil-and-hiddenness bridge, so the no-contact default applies. Support for the pro motion bridge is excluded because this is one moral line rather than the complete cumulative and comparative motion proposition.

bundles.evidenceText: the three facts that I mentioned are agreed upon by the majority of historians today
bundles.rationale: The move asserts that the burial, empty tomb, appearances, and origin of the disciples' belief are accepted historical facts even by cited skeptical scholars. This supports the evidential premises of the pro resurrection subsidiary bridge and therefore increases the credibility of God raising Jesus as their explanation. No contact is incompatible. Support for the pro central bridge is excluded because this atomic move concerns only the resurrection evidential line, not cumulative convergence of all five lines.

bundles.evidenceText: I simply infer to a being of enormous power for what these arguments demonstrate
bundles.rationale: In context, the move asserts that fine-tuning supports an enormously powerful cosmic intelligence while conceding that it does not by itself establish infinite power. This supports the pro fine-tuning subsidiary bridge's intelligent-design inference. The limitation to enormous rather than infinite power is compatible with that bridge and still increases its credibility. No contact is the nearest competitor but is excluded because the contextual antecedent of the inference is specifically fine-tuning as evidence of cosmic intelligence.
